subject: MSA/SOW: ClearWave - SLA exhibit tailoring & evidence request
messages:
From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Miller <laura.miller@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MSA/SOW - request: SLA exhibit tailoring + evidence pack

Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement and legal at ClearWave ran through the MSA and are asking for a tailored SLA exhibit to be attached to the SOW/order form. High level asks:

- Contracted availability: 99.95% monthly for the endpoints serving our production traffic (edge -> model serving).
- Latency target: P95 < 250ms for standard text generation routes (exceptions for model training/large-batch jobs).
- Clear definition of measurement intervals, maintenance windows, and rollback/fallback behaviors.
- Remedies: sliding credit scale capped at 10% of monthly invoice.

They also require evidence of monitoring and controls: SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months), sample uptime/latency measurement exports for a 30-day window, and a brief description of your incident response for service-impacting events.

Attached is a short PDF with their requested exhibit fields (ClearWave_SLA_Exhibit_Requested.pdf). Could you confirm whether Redwood can commit to the availability/latency wording, or propose alternate language? Procurement would like a clean copy to go to DocuSign by 2026-11-15 if possible.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager, ClearWave Health
procurement@clearwavehealth.com

Attachments: ClearWave_SLA_Exhibit_Requested.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA/SOW - request: SLA exhibit tailoring + evidence pack

Tom — thanks for the detail and the PDF. We're happy to work through this. I copied legal (Karthik) and platform (Monica) to scope what we can contractually commit to and to assemble the evidence pack.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope appropriately:
1) Is the 99.95% availability requirement intended to apply to the hosted API endpoints only (hosted inference), or to dedicated/private deployments as well?
2) For latency, will the P95 250ms target be measured on your side (edge-to-client) or from Redwood's telemetry? We can provide both but the contract should specify the measurement source.
3) Remedies: can you confirm the expectation around credit calculation (per-incident vs monthly aggregate)?

I'm attaching our SLA exhibit template with initial suggested redlines — will iterate after Karthik/Monica review. Proposed timeline: internal review tomorrow, consolidated redlines back to you on Friday (11/06).

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: rwi_sla_exhibit_template_redlines.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: MSA/SOW - request: SLA exhibit tailoring + evidence pack

Hannah / Monica — reviewed Tom's requests. High-level legal guidance:

- We can accept contract language that ties availability to Redwood telemetry, provided we include clear measurement windows and exclude scheduled maintenance and force majeure.
- Cap credits at 10% of the monthly recurring charges — that's acceptable, but recommend we phrase remedies as monthly credits (not cash refunds) and include an absolute annual cap.
- For latency guarantees, strongly suggest we narrow to 'API request path A (text-generation standard model family)' and exclude heavy inference (e.g., large-batch, streaming with tools).
- Avoid a hard SLA on weekend availability for dedicated/private deployments where customers manage networking; offer best-effort plus escalation commitments instead.

I'll attach my comment memo. Monica, please flag any platform constraints (measurement, evaluation windows) we should surface.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: legal_sla_comments.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA/SOW - request: SLA exhibit tailoring + evidence pack

Tom — attached is our consolidated response and a redlined SLA exhibit (RWI_ClearWave_SLA_Exhibit_Redlines.docx). Summary of our positions:

- Availability: We can commit to 99.95% availability measured using Redwood telemetry for hosted API endpoints only. We will exclude scheduled maintenance windows (we propose a 4-hour monthly window with 72-hour advance notice for non-emergency maintenance).
- Latency: We can offer a P95 < 250ms target for the 'standard-generation' route measured by Redwood from egress to egress on our public API. Heavy-batch and streaming scenarios are excluded as noted in the exhibit.
- Remedies: Monthly service credits up to 10% of that month's recurring charges; annual cap of 30% of total paid fees for the year. Credits are applied to invoices, not refunds.
- Evidence: We'll provide SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where needed), and a 30-day monitoring export in CSV with timestamps and measurement points.

Action items / asks from ClearWave:
- Confirm whether the availability target must apply to Dedicated/Private deployments — if yes we need the specific topology and we'll provide an alternate exhibit.
- Procurement: please review the redlines and the legal comments. If acceptable, we'll prepare a clean exhibit for signature (we can route via DocuSign).

Proposed milestone: final sign-off and DocuSign by 2026-11-15. HubSpot link and draft DocuSign prepared below.

Thanks — we'll hold a short sync with engineering if you want to walk through the measurement mechanics.

-Hannah

Attachments: RWI_ClearWave_SLA_Exhibit_Redlines.docx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ClearWave-987654 , https://www.docusign.net/CF12345

From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>, Laura Miller <laura.miller@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA/SOW - request: SLA exhibit tailoring + evidence pack

Hannah — appreciate the clear summary and the redlines. Procurement will review the RWI redline document and legal note; we expect to come back with a small set of counterpoints by 2026-11-10. We do want the 99.95% availability to apply only to hosted (public) API — so that matches your approach.

Attaching our internal procurement checklist to make the remaining asks visible. If everything aligns after our review we'll aim for a DocuSign send by 2026-11-15.

Thanks,
Tom
Attachments: CW_procurement_checklist.pdf
